title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #8

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a Kenyan water body mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Lake Victoria
   B. River Beas
   C. River Rijubalika
   D. River Ganga

2. Why can children with special needs join the tree planting activity? (1 mark)
   A. Only adults can plant
   B. They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   C. They must not be included
   D. They are too weak

3. Which sacred plant belongs to Buddhist tradition because of the Buddha's enlightenment? (1 mark)
   A. Bodhi tree
   B. Ber tree
   C. Tulsi
   D. Sal tree

4. Which medical use of Tulsi is mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. A fuel for cars
   B. A tool for digging
   C. Tea for coughs and colds
   D. A cloth

5. What does water often stand for in religious life? (1 mark)
   A. Noise
   B. Anger
   C. Purity and a clean heart
   D. Hunger

6. Which teaching is linked with Guru Ram Das Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Equality and serving others
   B. Pride
   C. Wealth only
   D. War

7. Whom did Guru Ram Das Ji serve before becoming Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   B. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   C. Guru Amar Das Ji
   D. Guru Nanak

8. In which city was Guru Ram Das Ji born? (1 mark)
   A. Lumbini
   B. Lahore
   C. Nairobi
   D. Varanasi

9. For how many years was Ram asked to live in the forest? (1 mark)
   A. Fourteen
   B. Two
   C. Five
   D. Fifty

10. Who was the king of Ayodhya in the Ramayan? (1 mark)
   A. Suddhodana
   B. Harishchandra
   C. Dasharatha
   D. Hiranyakashipu

11. Which action follows the Jain teaching of gentleness? (1 mark)
   A. Chasing animals
   B. Throwing stones
   C. Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun
   D. Breaking eggs

12. Which is a bad habit during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Folding hands
   B. Listening
   C. Laughing or talking
   D. Sitting still

13. Which is a typical feature of Mandirs? (1 mark)
   A. A kitchen garden
   B. A bell rung gently on arrival
   C. A roaring engine
   D. A water tank

14. How can you show a Mandir in a drawing? (1 mark)
   A. A zigzag line
   B. A circle only
   C. A rectangle hall with a pointed spire
   D. A river

15. What does Kirat Karni mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Painting
   C. Travelling
   D. Earning by honest work

16. Which faith's story in the lesson is about truth and a king? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Hinduism
   C. Sikhism
   D. Jainism

17. Which is a benefit of integrity? (1 mark)
   A. People avoid us
   B. We are always angry
   C. We feel afraid
   D. People trust us

18. In Sasankasana, where do you rest your forehead? (1 mark)
   A. On a chair
   B. On the mat
   C. On your knees
   D. On the wall

19. Which tradition teaches the five principles in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Only the Buddhist tradition
   B. A market
   C. A trade union
   D. Sanatan or Vedic

20. Which of the five principles is about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Prarthana
   B. Prani Daya
   C. Punarjanam
   D. Purushartha

21. In the Shibi story, what did the hawk want? (1 mark)
   A. The dove as food
   B. Water
   C. A house
   D. A crown

22. In which months does Paryushan usually occur? (1 mark)
   A. February or March
   B. August or September
   C. June
   D. December

23. Which prayer is chanted on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu
   B. Ik Onkar
   C. Micchami Dukkadam
   D. Om Namah Shivaya

24. Which is a safety rule for festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Eat from the ground
   B. Ask an adult to light lamps
   C. Run in the temple
   D. Play with fire

25. Which day is linked with Jupiter? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Friday
   C. Saturday
   D. Tuesday

26. Which day is linked with Mars? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Saturday
   C. Thursday
   D. Tuesday

27. What does vaar mean? (1 mark)
   A. Planet
   B. Month
   C. Year
   D. Day of the week

28. Ravi is another name for which heavenly body? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. The Moon
   C. The Sun
   D. Venus

29. How many days are in the week in the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Eight
   C. Six
   D. Five

30. Which day is linked with Saturn? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Sunday
   C. Monday
   D. Thursday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Why should we not bully others, according to the teachings in this lesson? (2 marks)

32. Name the four Purusharthas. (2 marks)

33. Describe the story of King Shibi and the dove and give its lesson. (4 marks)

34. Why do the festival dates in this calendar change from year to year on our usual calendar? (2 marks)

35. State three ways of showing respect to the National flag and Anthem. (3 marks)

36. Explain why the River Rijubalika is important to Jains. (3 marks)

37. What does Dainik Prarthana mean? (2 marks)

38. Explain four lessons we learn from the Ramayan. (4 marks)

39. Describe the story of Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo and its lesson. (4 marks)

40. Explain the four Purusharthas with one example each for a child. (4 marks)

41. What is a festival? (2 marks)

42. Describe how to sit in Vajra Asana. (3 marks)

43. Explain why the time and place of the defeat of Hiranyakashipu are special in the story. (3 marks)

44. Explain why water is important in our daily lives. (3 marks)

45. On which date is Madaraka Day and what does Madaraka mean? (2 marks)

46. Explain what the story of King Harishchandra teaches. (3 marks)

47. Explain why yoga should be practised with an expert. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Lake Victoria
   Lake Victoria is in Kenya; the other three are in India.

2. B — They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

3. A — Bodhi tree
   Bodhi tree is the tree of awakening.

4. C — Tea for coughs and colds
   Tulsi leaves are used in home medicine such as tea.

5. C — Purity and a clean heart
   Because water cleans, it is a sign of purity.

6. A — Equality and serving others
   He taught that all people are equal and service is important.

7. C — Guru Amar Das Ji
   He served the third Guru with humility.

8. B — Lahore
   He was born in Lahore.

9. A — Fourteen
   Kaikeyi asked that Ram go for fourteen years.

10. C — Dasharatha
   King Dasharatha ruled Ayodhya.

11. C — Not stepping on ants or hurting animals for fun
   Gentleness to living things is central.

12. C — Laughing or talking
   We should be quiet and respectful.

13. B — A bell rung gently on arrival
   The bell announces arrival.

14. C — A rectangle hall with a pointed spire
   A hall with a spire is a simple model.

15. D — Earning by honest work
   Kirat Karni is honest labour.

16. B — Hinduism
   The Harishchandra story.

17. D — People trust us
   Honest people are trusted.

18. B — On the mat
   The forehead rests on the mat.

19. D — Sanatan or Vedic
   It is the ancient Hindu way.

20. C — Punarjanam
   Rebirth.

21. A — The dove as food
   The hawk demanded the dove.

22. B — August or September
   It falls in Bhadrapada.

23. D — Om Namah Shivaya
   It is a well-known prayer to Shiva.

24. B — Ask an adult to light lamps
   Adults should handle flames.

25. A — Thursday
   Guruvaar.

26. D — Tuesday
   Mangalvaar.

27. D — Day of the week
   Vaar means day.

28. C — The Sun
   Ravi is the Sun.

29. A — Seven
   Seven days.

30. A — Saturday
   Shanivaar.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enlightened Beings teach kindness and Ahimsa, so we should not harm others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness or Ahimsa, 1 mark for a link to bullying.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: A frightened dove flew into the king's lap and a hawk demanded it. The king offered his own flesh to save the dove. The lesson is that a kind person protects the weak.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dove, 1 mark for the hawk, 1 mark for the offer, 1 mark for the lesson.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: The months follow the Moon, so the dates move.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stand straight, be quiet, never let the flag touch the ground, learn and sing the anthem (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains believe Lord Mahavir became fully enlightened while sitting on its bank, so the river is honoured in Jainism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Jain link, 1 mark for Lord Mahavir, 1 mark for enlightenment.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Daily prayers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for daily and 1 mark for prayers.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep promises, respect elders, be humble, do not be greedy for power, love your brothers and sisters, and be courageous (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guru Nanak chose to eat at the home of Bhai Lalo, an honest carpenter, instead of Malik Bhago's feast. The lesson is that honest work is the best way to earn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Bhai Lalo, 1 mark for choosing his home, 1 mark for honest labour, 1 mark for the lesson.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Dharma: doing homework and telling the truth. Artha: saving pocket money honestly. Kama: enjoying play and friendship. Moksha: praying and growing kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: A special day or set of days when people come together to remember something important.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for special day and 1 mark for remembering or celebrating together.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kneel with knees together, bring big toes close, sit back on your heels, keep the back and head straight and place palms on the thighs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three correct steps.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha was neither man nor animal, it was neither day nor night, and it happened at the doorway, neither inside nor outside, so the king's gift did not protect him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three details.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Water is needed for drinking and cooking, for washing and cleaning, and for growing crops and giving drinks to animals. Without it people, animals and plants cannot live.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three correct points.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 1 June; power or authority to govern.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gave up his kingdom rather than break his promise and never told a lie, so it teaches that truth is worth more than wealth and comfort.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the promise, 1 mark for truth, 1 mark for the lesson.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: An expert shows the correct posture, corrects mistakes, prevents strain of the back or knees, and knows when to stop.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.
